scope: Private evaluateCandidateCatalogScan over an originally issued program and the entire validated supplied target-type fact population; trusted complete-cut premise. No query parser/compiler, native authority, backend qualification, or public root API.

actualSourceWeakenings.qualification: Each mutant runs in a separate private source copy; intended semantic assertion failures are required, while thrown/import/setup errors are rejected. Eight diffs and focused mutated module copies are retained.

reviewConclusions: The new operation is an explicit separate entry point. Existing subset action/collection semantics remain unchanged; the independent corpus directly compares a legal one-row subset with a three-row scan.

The one packet snapshot precedes owner/read-action derivation. Selection is exactly {type,fields}; caller resources/action/limit/predicate/native binding members refuse. Accessor controls refuse without invoking selection, owner or cut getters.

Every supplied Record fact is typed and its normalized Key/projections validated before scan target enumeration. The target population comes from the validated byType index exactly once in source fact order. Unknown or malformed unselected facts still refuse.

Derived selector count is charged before map allocation and added to existing facts+graphs aggregate maxFacts. It stays inside the original operation and literal/output ledgers; the new entry does not reset evaluation or rendering budgets.
The actual detached owner read action is used, with the existing source read-purpose and policy checks. A custom action-name positive detects a hardcoded read-action substitution.

Field-free scans still evaluate each row read. Denials filter; late unknown/conflict clears all rows. Empty target populations retain existing source condition/output preflight. Original null, known absence, withheld and inline transformation retain separate cell meanings.

Flat association, Record-backed graph and opaque graph examples all scan the full population while filtering by actual supplied membership. These are logical-cut controls, not native fact custody evidence.
No new root export exists. Weft remains responsible for per-occurrence query read requirements and the native consumer for current authority/cut/dispatch binding.

formalAssessment.acceptedMeaning: Conditional unbounded prefix invariant: final release has every and only permitted row index, any U/conflict prevents release, field-free denied rows are not emitted, empty populations still require source preflight. Four SAT controls establish nonvacuity and expose subset/native-auth gaps.

limitations: Finite controls plus separate conditional model, not a universal security theorem.
Supplied completeness/trust remains a host premise; a caller can fabricate an incomplete cut outside this API guarantee.
